methodology: Charges derived from TENET5 Criminal Code Analyzer cross-referencing 15 public data sources against Criminal Code of Canada sections. These are potential applicability findings, NOT formal charges. All persons are presumed innocent. Legal review required.
disclaimer: This document does not constitute legal advice or formal criminal charges. It identifies patterns in public data that may warrant further investigation under the specified Criminal Code sections. The s.504 mechanism allows any citizen to lay an information before a justice — but legal counsel should be consulted first.
